name: Invisible Wall
source:
Can you find happiness?

Welcome to a dark story of sorrowful love...

Imagine the picture - a young couple move into a new apartment after the wedding, but the husband has to leave immediately on a business trip for an indefinite period. Not the best honeymoon, to say the least.

But that’s not the only problem that has fallen on their shoulders - a strange woman has started to visit the apartment.

Loneliness, confusion, and anxiety - this is how the story begins. But how it ends is up to you...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3515690/]Steam[/url]]
